sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Radiolabeled competition binding assay and calcium mobilization assay both performed; chemokine binding on the extracellular surface and G-protein coupling on the intracellular surface were not hindered — values comparable to published literature (L2/L3).
sites.rationale: CCR1 is a GPCR with no signal peptide; the N-terminus (residues 1–35) is fully extracellular per the provided topology landmarks. A tag prepended before M1 (insert_after_residue=0) is 35 residues from the TM1 boundary, well beyond the ≥3-residue minimum. Python verification confirms residue 1 = M and residue 35 = Q (last EC1 residue before TM1 at 36). The position is topology-derived because no specific residue number is named in the ledger — the paper states 'N-terminus' of full-length CCR1, and with no signal peptide there is exactly one extracellular N-terminal junction. Functional validation (L2/L3) confirms binding and signaling are preserved. Full-length human CCR1 expressed with HA, His8, and/or StrepII tags cloned onto the N-terminus (and/or C-terminus) in a mammalian/insect expression system (PMC2706832). CCR1 has no signal peptide; the N-terminus (residues 1–35) is extracellular per topology landmarks, so the tag prepends before M1. A second independent study (PMC8885419, L4) fused a FLAG tag to the same N-terminus of full-length CCR1 in pcDNA3.1.

sources.claim: Nucleotides encoding HA (Hemagglutinin), His8 and/or StrepII (IBA, Germany) tags were cloned onto the N- and/or C-termini of human CCR1, CCR2, CCR3 and CCR5 constructs (see Supplementary Figure S1 for DNA sequences).

literature_notes: L4 (PMC8885419, FLAG tag at N-terminus of full-length CCR1) independently corroborates the same N-terminal prepend junction as L1 but reports no functional assay; it does not add a second distinct site. L1 is used as the primary ledger line because it carries full functional validation (L2/L3). The C-terminal tags mentioned in L1 and L5 are intracellular and are recorded in other_positions. No ledger line supports any internal extracellular loop insertion for CCR1.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal HA/His8/StrepII tags placed on full-length CCR1; residue 355 (F) falls in IC4 (305–355), the intracellular C-tail — not a surface-tag site.
Rluc8 BRET fragment inserted at C-terminus of CCR1(1–327); residue 327 (W) is within IC4 (305–355) and is therefore intracellular — not a surface-tag site.
